title: Podkletnov's impulse gravitational generator

tellings.quote: I believe if Glennov has hit on something already and if it's true that he has made this impulse gravitational generator.

plain: A Russian scientist named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have built an "impulse gravitational generator," a machine meant to throw out a pulse of gravity-like force. Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, brings it up without naming a source. He frames it with care: "if it's true that he has made this," then Podkletnov "has hit on something," which would mean gravity can be produced and controlled by a machine.
